behavior: A freelancer or merchant profile needs billing details before its first invoice, so the payer always sees who bills them
acceptance: Creating an invoice for a freelancer or merchant profile without billing details is 409 billing_details_required, so every business invoice carries an issuer (name, address, country, email); a personal profile's request still needs none and names its sender (D-52).

New invoice on a freelancer or merchant profile without billing details shows, in place of the form, that the invoice needs them and an Add billing details button; saving them there returns to New invoice with the form.
axe 0 and no sideways scroll at 390 px on the prompt; the mocked app and the live e2e profiles carry billing details.
notes: 2026-10-17 review pass by reviewer: PASS. Backend: create.go reads kind and billing-details EXISTS in the same SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inside the create transaction, after the idempotency replay, so a replay of an existing invoice still returns it; a refused create returns before any insert and the tx rolls back (TestBusinessInvoiceNeedsBillingDetails proves the same key later makes number 1). Race free: no DELETE of profile_billing_details anywhere, profile kind never changes, profiles are never deleted, and the insert trigger runs with a later snapshot. 409 billing_details_required is in httpio/errors.go, the openapi enum and createInvoice 409 (CreateInvoiceConflict), and api.md. Personal requests still work without details (tested). Only one API caller and one web caller create invoices; invoice, settlement, httpapi and backend e2e gate setups gained details; load_test uses personal profiles and direct SQL. Rewritten tests still test their claims; TestCreateInvoiceRefusesUnsettleableTerms still reaches buildTerms. Web: prompt, skeleton while billing loads, form on GET error (API still checks); ?then= maps only to newInvoice or home, Cancel uses the same next; mock and live helper correct. Old business invoices with no issuer still render. Checks I ran: go test ./internal/... all ok, go vet ./... ok, vitest 87 passed, typecheck ok, biome ok. Minor notes, not blocking: (1) new-invoice-screen.tsx:82 the prompt link drops ?from=, so Duplicate (R-91) or a closed invoice's next step on a profile without details lands on an empty form after saving; (2) pay-invoice.tsx:242 labels any invoice without issuer as Request, so a business invoice made before R-92 reads Request INV-000N (legacy only, pre-existing); (3) create.go:66 hardcodes 'personal' though profile.Personal exists and invoice already imports profile; (4) TestInvoicePDF no longer covers a PDF with neither issuer nor sender (no FROM block), yet its doc comment at invoices_pdf_test.go:119 still claims it; (5) if the billing GET fails the form shows and a 409 becomes the generic 'We could not create the invoice. Try again.'; (6) billing-details-form.tsx:30 prop comment only says what the prop does; sample-api.ts billing is typed object; (7) pre-existing, not this task: list_search_test.go:109 posts to the walletless profile, which has no wallet, so that other-profile invoice is never made.

proof.1: unit: httpapi TestBusinessInvoiceNeedsBillingDetails: a merchant with a wallet and no billing details gets 409 billing_details_required, and after saving them the same key makes INV-0001 with an issuer (the refused one stored nothing); a personal profile's request is 201 with no issuer and its sender name; TestInvoicePDF prints the request's sender as not checked; invoice, settlement and API test profiles carry billing details
proof.2: e2e: navigation 'New invoice asks for billing details first, then comes back to the form' shows the empty state with Add billing details and no Create invoice, saves the details on /app/billing-details?then=new-invoice and lands back on New invoice with the form; the live invoices helper does the same for the shared merchant profile before its first invoice
proof.3: e2e: the same navigation test finds no sideways scroll at 390 px and no blocking axe violations on the prompt; sample-api serves billing details for the mocked merchant (null for that test); the live E2E shop profile saved them through the form
